solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: American city allowing Swiss currency in various casinos

indicators.note: in places the currency inside the jumbled letters of the gambling houses
various suggests the letters of casinos in a different order

parts.note: the franc is the currency of Switzerland

explanation.surface: A US city permits gamblers to use Swiss money in several of its casinos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'allowing' is only a link here; the indicators are 'various' for the anagram and 'in' for the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: A major Californian port on the Pacific coast, known for the Golden Gate Bridge.

clue.text: Examined contents of her case at sea, heading for Dover

indicators.note: at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters are muddled
heading for points to the first letter of the port's name

explanation.surface: A customs officer goes through a woman's luggage on a ferry bound for Dover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' rearranges HER CASE into SEARCHE; 'heading for' takes D from Dover.
explanation.definitionFit: To search a bag is to look through everything inside it, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Cab turned up at eleven

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means the little word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: XI is eleven in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A cab arrived at eleven o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: A cab is a hired car with a driver, the same vehicle by another name.

clue.text: Name of lady, one married old dope

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
gen and dope are both slang for information

explanation.surface: A woman's name, and a single lady who wed an old fool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' looks like a fool but means inside information, GEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, as borne by the heroine of Shakespeare's Cymbeline.

clue.text: Killer donkeys at home

parts.note: donkeys, plural, taken as a pair of asses, ASS twice
in means at home, as in staying in

explanation.surface: A murderer is hiding out with the donkeys back at the farm.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a murderer, especially one hired to kill a prominent person.

clue.text: Heard Hungarian composer's record

indicators.note: heard tells us the composer's name is spoken, and we write what it sounds like

parts.note: Franz Liszt was the Hungarian pianist and composer

explanation.surface: Someone has listened to a recording of a Hungarian composer's music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'record' looks like a disc; it is a verb or noun meaning to write down in a register.
explanation.definitionFit: To list items is to record them one after another in a written register.

clue.text: Stadium near redeveloped area

indicators.note: redeveloped means rebuilt in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sports ground sits close to a district undergoing regeneration.
explanation.definitionFit: An enclosed venue for sport or entertainment with seating round a central space.

clue.text: Large dog getting mother tense

parts.note: ma is a familiar word for mother
tense muscles are stiff

explanation.surface: A big dog makes Mum nervous.
explanation.definitionFit: A mastiff is a powerful breed of guard dog, an example of a large canine.

clue.text: Violinists' bows rot

definitions.meaning: read literally, the sticks used to play fiddles
rot is nonsense, and the exclamation means nonsense!

explanation.definitionFit: A fiddle bow is literally a stick, and the old exclamation dismisses talk as rubbish.

clue.text: Distant rulers in China once working on the land

parts.note: far means distant
the Ming dynasty ruled China from 1368 to 1644

explanation.surface: Remote emperors of old China tilled the soil.
explanation.definitionFit: Agriculture is cultivating crops or raising livestock, exactly the work of the land.

clue.text: Bill and Edward had roles in play

parts.note: AC, short for account, is a bill
Ted is a pet form of Edward

explanation.surface: Two men called Bill and Edward were cast in a stage production.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man's name but gives AC, an account.
explanation.definitionFit: Performers who took parts in a stage production performed them on stage.

clue.text: A Democrat, he hires out supporters

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for a US Democrat
to rent something is to hire it out

explanation.surface: A US politician brings in hired help to back him up.
explanation.definitionFit: Followers or backers of a cause or party, loyal to it.

clue.text: Don't forget about person in the club

parts.note: re means about or concerning
someone who belongs to a club is a member

explanation.surface: A reminder not to overlook someone who belongs to the club.
explanation.definitionFit: Keep in mind is the positive form of not letting something slip from memory.

clue.text: Friend starts to prosper, at length

indicators.note: starts to points to the first letter of each of the next three words

explanation.surface: A mate finally begins to do well after a long time.
explanation.definitionFit: A pal is an informal word for a close companion or mate.

clue.text: Plan for new soap to have late start

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: new tells us the letters of soap are made into a fresh arrangement
start means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A scheme to launch a new TV soap opera in a late-evening slot.
explanation.definitionFit: A suggested scheme put forward for consideration, a synonym of plan.

clue.text: Fish medic sent back

indicators.note: sent back means the word is turned round to read the other way

parts.note: a doc is a doctor, a medic

explanation.surface: A fish dish returned to the kitchen by a doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: A common North Atlantic food fish, an example of the general term.

clue.text: Significant warning sign to America, after end of Vietnam

indicators.note: after puts the warning sign and what follows behind that single letter
end of picks the final letter of the country's name

parts.note: an omen is a sign of things to come
US is short for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A grave warning to the USA in the closing stages of the Vietnam War.
explanation.definitionFit: A momentous event is one of great importance or consequence.

clue.text: Greek character heads insignificant rebellion

parts.note: mu is the twelfth letter of the Greek alphabet
tiny means very small, insignificant

explanation.surface: A Greek figure leads a minor revolt.
explanation.definitionFit: An uprising against authority, especially by sailors or soldiers against officers.

clue.text: This trumpeter shows one way to play an instrument

definitions.text: one way to play an instrument

indicators.note: shows means the letters are on display inside the two words

explanation.surface: A trumpeter demonstrates a technique for playing.
explanation.walkthrough: You don't strum a trumpet, which adds to the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: Strumming is brushing the fingers across strings, as on a guitar.

clue.text: Rough rugby side? Not the first half

parts.note: RU stands for Rugby Union

indicators.note: not the first half means the opening two of the four letters of side are dropped

explanation.surface: A rugby team plays roughly, at least in the second half.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not the first half' removes SI from SIDE, leaving DE.
explanation.definitionFit: Rude in the sense of crude or unpolished, as in a rude shelter.

clue.text: Capital tour to west of oil-rig, oddly

indicators.note: in an across clue, west of means placed to the left of

parts.note: a trip is a journey or tour

indicators.note: oddly picks the first, third and fifth letters of the hyphenated word

explanation.surface: A capital-city tour that goes west of an oil platform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' takes O, L, I from OIL-RIG.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city of Libya, on the Mediterranean coast.

clue.text: Desire to remove lead from dog

indicators.note: taking the lead off means dropping the first letter of the dog word

parts.note: a bitch is a female dog

explanation.surface: An urge to unclip a dog's leash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lead' looks like a leash but means the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An itch is a restless craving or longing, as in an itch to travel.

clue.text: Vegetable no longer fresh, mate

parts.note: food that is no longer fresh is old
a bean is a vegetable

explanation.surface: A vegetable past its best, my friend.
explanation.walkthrough: OLD BEAN is a dated, upper-class British way to address a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: A jovial old-fashioned British form of address for a friend or chum.

clue.text: Break savoury biscuit without hesitation

indicators.note: without means the hesitation sound is removed from the biscuit

parts.note: a cracker is a crisp savoury biscuit
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Snap a savoury biscuit in two without delay.
explanation.definitionFit: To crack something is to break or split it, a direct synonym.
